value.rationale: The edge probability is the natural rare-event observable for finite-speed confined motility near the propulsion-supported turning point. Its exact logarithmic multiplicity and computable non-elementary entrance-gap coefficient resolve information the general renewal integral equations do not supply. Comparing Erlang shape at fixed mean residence time yields a strict physically motivated hierarchy, identifying run-time regularity in exceptionally thin wall-adjacent populations; the statement is not a numerical curiosity or a mere renaming of the known Poisson beta density.
